page.layout: One printed block only: the ownership inscription in the centre of the page, below which is a handwritten shelf mark. Library stamps, labels and manuscript marks at the left and bottom are not printed text and are left out.
page.notes: The page is a bookplate-style title leaf with an ownership inscription. The large handwritten "25.9" below the inscription is manuscript and is not transcribed. The stamps at the upper left ("10 / 3-D / 2" and the octagonal "Biblioteca Nazionale Vittorio Emanuele" stamp "10 6 I 45"), the manuscript marks at the lower left and bottom, the dark label at the bottom centre, and the "Digitized by Google" credit at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
